evidence.title: Daou 2026 half-year filing: Jukjeon CDC currently being built
evidence.excerpt: The issuer's business narrative explicitly identifies its Yongin Jukjeon data center as currently being built and separately contrasts Jukjeon CDC with its operating data centers. This is a named physical-build assertion, not merely a construction asset balance or an opening forecast.
